name: listing-page
title: Listing
description: One property, room to look. A wide photograph, the price and key figures, a gallery, video and walk-through tour, then open-house and visit details. Built for a phone first.

images.purpose: the wide opening photograph: the actual exterior or best room, with space around the property
images.alt_hint: Describe the real property and viewpoint, without a sales claim.
images.prompt: Use the owner’s actual property photograph. Do not generate or invent a property, room, view or feature.

images.purpose: the photo gallery in the listing entry: put each ![description](image) in its own paragraph after the Photos heading
images.alt_hint: Name the room and what is visible, e.g. The kitchen looking toward the garden.
images.prompt: Use actual photographs supplied for this property. Keep the rooms, proportions, finishes and views truthful.

images.purpose: the picture shared in messages; otherwise the hero is used
images.prompt: Crop the real hero photograph to a wide share image. Do not alter the property.

content.purpose: the property name or address in the top bar
a short, factual headline for the property
the location and one sentence about the home
the asking price and availability, exactly as confirmed by the owner
one feature stream for the main listing entry; put the stat tiles in entry.stats and the photo gallery, video, 3D tour and open-house details in its body

Use headings such as Photos, Video tour, Walk through and Open house. Put each picture in its own paragraph. Put !embed[Video tour](https://…) and !embed[3D tour](https://…) on their own lines, in place. Each source needs owner approval. Heading ids make /listing/home/#video-tour work.
the primary action with cta_link, e.g. Arrange a visit, linking to an on-site heading or the contact method
a second action with cta2_link, e.g. Video tour to /listing/home/#video-tour
short menu links to on-site headings, e.g. /listing/home/#photos and /listing/home/#video-tour
the owner-approved visit contact, phone/email and map link; never publish private contact details without approval
a short note about arranging a visit, shown with contact information
the agent/owner’s required listing disclaimer or confirmed attribution

art.ask: Ask for the actual property photographs: a wide exterior or best-room hero, then a curated set of room, garden and view photos. Ask which details may be public.
art.style: Real property photography in natural light. Preserve the actual rooms, proportions, finishes, views and surroundings. Never invent or materially alter a property. No engravings, animal mascots or generated room photographs.
art.prompt_prefix: Use the owner-supplied photograph of this property; keep it truthful.
steps: Get the real property photos and confirm the asking price, location, room counts and visit details with the owner.
Choose a wide hero and a small set of useful gallery views. Do not invent a missing room, view or feature.
Shrink pictures to web size, about 2400 pixels on the long side and usually under 1 MB; originals need the existing plain warning first.
Write a useful description for each photo. Put gallery pictures in separate Markdown paragraphs in the main listing entry.
Add the video and 3D-tour URLs as !embed lines under their own headings; request approval for each new source.
Check the phone layout, menu anchors, contact details, map and media, then run site_check with deep:true before asking for approval.
